_comment: S-L1 attribution hook for the F-A2 key widening (Q-L1-01, SS N-62; PR #2858). Follows the draft schema of attribution_hooks.json (ruling name + categories + category_regex + note), extended with the exact table, the expected before/after/delta per category and the acceptance criteria. Counts are the canonical chart 482012f1-710e-4a25-994a-93821f5871aa; they come from an offline model of the shipping writer that reproduces the live pre-state per category exactly (see F_A2_KEY_WIDENING_D6_PLAN_v1_0.md section 3). The model is an expectation, not a measurement: the post-run table is the measurement (s_l1_ga_vargas_acceptance_check.sql).
name: F-A2

changes.grain: 96 rows per (ayanamsha, varga) x 5 ayanamshas x 30 vargas; only the Aries/S1 bindus row per graha-varga survived before
12 rows per (ayanamsha, varga); a lord of two houses kept only one before
60 rows per ayanamsha (5 lords x 12 signs); 10 survived before
D81 sentinel + five floored bodies (Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Lilith, MC); one row per body

expectations: every row gained is in one of the four categories above; no other fact_category on chart_divisionals changes its row count
no existing row changes value: the gained rows are NEW keys that the six-column unique key silently dropped
no chart_facts, ga_* or any other table changes because of F-A2 (the capture identity widens, which affects only l1_data_plane_* snapshots of chart_divisionals)

1c826d5a-41cb-4450-b4dc-59d440e5f75a.note: after a rebuild with the current writer; the extra 850 over the canonical delta are the D30 main-loop rows the F-A3 fix restores; krishnamurti and surya_siddhanta_classical VALUES also change (pre-#1053 Lahiri fallback), which belongs to the ephemeris/S-L1b hooks, not to F-A2

criteria.C4: 12 varga_house_lord rows per ayanamsha x varga (150 pairs)
criteria.C5: 96 varga_ashtakavarga rows per ayanamsha x varga (150 pairs)

caveat: C1/C2 include varga_deity_attribution, which follows bg_shashtiamsha_deities (production: 60 rows, deity_name NULL, 135 rows per ayanamsha); a change to that table would move the totals, not the four hooked categories.
